reply_text:
The files are clean. I'll make one run of the reader compute the gap charts at 6, 1 and 0 hours together, then start a 7-day run on your logs in the background.While that runs, I'll write the figure section for the page.The run finished: 306 turns typed by you, 6.5 billion agent tokens, and 6, 17 and 280 bars at thresholds of 6, 1 and 0 hours. Now building the page and staging it.Only the ordinary word "jsonl" from the model's vocabulary matched, not a path. There are 303 bars (6 + 17 + 280). Committing.Gist: The 小象 page on staging now opens with the charts, placed right after the sentence box under the heading "What the download shows, on my own logs". It has three gap charts built from your last 7 days of logs, with gaps of 6 hours, 1 hour and none, followed by a bar chart of the kinds of request you make. I left out the credential counts. Should the count of credentials in your logs go on a public page as well?

**What the charts show** (306 turns typed by you, 6.5 billion tokens logged by agents):

| Chart | Bars | Share of agent tokens |
|---|---|---|
| `--gap-hours 6`: nights and long trips | 6 | 13% |
| `--gap-hours 1`: an hour or more away from the keyboard | 17 | 48% |
| `--gap-hours 0`: every stretch between two typed turns | 280 | 100% |

Each chart has a one-line caption, and hovering a bar shows its dates and token count. The intent chart notes that 小象's readings are often wrong and says how many turns had too little to go on.

**Where the figures come from:**
- **One run:** a single pass of the downloadable file over your logs, with its output saved on Zone in `~/.local/share/xiaoxiang/sample-report.json`. To refresh the charts, rerun that and rebuild the page.
- **What they use:** dates, hours, and token and intent counts only; no turn text, file paths or credential findings.
- **Checked:** a new test confirms that a file path in the report doesn't reach the page. A search of the built page for "jsonl" found only the ordinary word in the model's vocabulary, not a path.

**Why the download could show all three charts:** I changed the reader so that one run computes all three thresholds. Before, it would have taken three runs of about 7 minutes each. The file on the home page predates this change. It still works, and it still draws one chart at whatever `--gap-hours` you choose. It just doesn't write the extra views into its `--json` output.

**Commits:** futon3c fef7ff25 and futon7 33ed241. Staging is rebuilt, and nothing is live yet. To publish, copy `futon7/site-draft/xiaoxiang.html` to futon7a and push.
